headline: Consulting contract with Jeanne Boyle Consulting, LLC for brownfields remediation, plus invoices of $13,050.00 and $5,000.00.
summary: The agenda lists a consulting contract for brownfields remediation and two invoices. It also covers a budget update and two executive sessions, on the Downtown Gateway and on Fuller Mill Realty, LLC.
